instruction: Look at the book reading spreadsheet on the desktop. Find all books that received a perfect 5-star rating, and write the title of the one that was read FIRST (earliest start date) into the document 'book_list_result.docx' on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding 5-star rated books and selecting the one read earliest. Verified from Excel: 4 books have 5.0 rating (Fire and Blood, Song of Solomon, The Andromeda Strain, Silence). Fire and Blood started on 2022-01-01, which is the earliest.

Metric function properly handles expected parameter - correctly accesses expected.get('expected_text') when expected.type='rule'

Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the docx file from VM
